title: Permission
subtitle: the door held from within
mapEpigraph: The hand on the latch has been yours all along.

prompts.text: Where did you learn to wait for permission?
What does the want sound like before you trim it into something reasonable?
What have I been waiting for permission to want?

blocks.title: One inch of room
blocks.instruction: Speak the desire, actually say it aloud privately. Then make one inch of room for it—a line in the calendar, a blank page, a name on a folder. Nothing public is required.

blocks.closing: Let the desire enter at its original size.
